name: TIC 350820336

text.card: A red giant 1,104 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.08 solar masses and 17.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,606 K at its surface.
